Module.Title: PF2E Affliction Forge: Venoms & Toxins
Module.Description: An original bilingual poison library for PF2E Affliction Forge with natural venoms, alchemical toxins, and semantic Creature Forge tags.
Module.LibraryDescription: Original natural and artificial poisons, fully tagged for semantic Creature Forge assignment.

cellar-spider-venom.Name: Cellar Spider Venom
cellar-spider-venom.Description: The venom of small cellar hunters causes burning pain and temporary unsteadiness in the limbs.

nettle-sap.Name: Nettle Sap
nettle-sap.Description: A concentrated plant sap irritates skin and mucous membranes, making the affected area swell.

dune-scorpion-venom.Name: Dune Scorpion Venom
dune-scorpion-venom.Description: The clear venom of a small desert scorpion makes muscles tremble and joints stiffen.

dockside-ratbane.Name: Dockside Ratbane
dockside-ratbane.Description: A bitter pest poison that is difficult to notice in food and quickly causes stomach cramps.

marsh-viper-venom.Name: Marsh Viper Venom
marsh-viper-venom.Description: This greenish snake venom impairs muscle control and causes painful cramping.

smokeleaf-toxin.Name: Smokeleaf Toxin
smokeleaf-toxin.Description: Dried smokeleaf produces an acrid haze when burned, irritating eyes and lungs.

cobalt-frog-secretion.Name: Cobalt Frog Secretion
cobalt-frog-secretion.Description: The skin of a bright blue frog secretes a neurotoxin that distorts touch and balance.

blackglass-needle-poison.Name: Blackglass Needle Poison
blackglass-needle-poison.Description: A thin alchemical poison formulated for needles, arrows, and narrow blades.

cave-widow-venom.Name: Cave Widow Venom
cave-widow-venom.Description: The venom of pale cave spiders slows nerve conduction and makes even small movements uncertain.

choking-lime-toxin.Name: Choking Lime Toxin
choking-lime-toxin.Description: This fine alchemical powder draws moisture from the mouth and airways, triggering violent coughing.

reefspine-venom.Name: Reefspine Venom
reefspine-venom.Description: The venom of an iridescent reef fish burns in the wound and sends muscles into painful spasms.

crimson-ichor.Name: Crimson Ichor
crimson-ichor.Description: A sticky weapon coating that ruptures tiny blood vessels and repeatedly reopens the wound.

Stage1.Name: Stage 1
Stage1.Description: 2d6 poison damage and 1d4 persistent bleed damage.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 3d6 poison damage and 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

dusk-adder-venom.Name: Dusk Adder Venom
dusk-adder-venom.Description: The dark venom of this nocturnal snake dulls the senses and gradually paralyzes the muscles.

fever-dust.Name: Fever Dust
fever-dust.Description: A yellow powder that immediately causes fever, dizziness, and muscle tremors when inhaled.

carrion-wasp-venom.Name: Carrion Wasp Venom
carrion-wasp-venom.Description: The venom of large carrion wasps breaks down tissue and weakens circulation within a few heartbeats.

moonmilk-toxin.Name: Moonmilk Toxin
moonmilk-toxin.Description: A toxic mineral paste from deep caves causes numbness and a disturbing loss of bodily awareness.

obsidian-scorpion-venom.Name: Obsidian Scorpion Venom
obsidian-scorpion-venom.Description: The pitch-black venom of a volcanic scorpion sends stabbing heat through nerves and muscles.

Stage2.Name: Stage 2
Stage2.Description: 4d6 poison damage, 1d6 fire damage, and clumsy 1.

Stage3.Description: 5d6 poison damage, 2d6 fire damage, and clumsy 2.

assassins-sap.Name: Assassin's Sap
assassins-sap.Description: A nearly colorless resin used to coat weapons, quickly making a victim's legs feel leaden.

glassfang-venom.Name: Glassfang Venom
glassfang-venom.Description: The venom of a rare translucent snake bursts blood vessels beneath the skin and weakens the limbs.

Stage3.Description: 6d6 poison damage, 2d6 persistent bleed damage, and enfeebled 1.

grave-lotus-distillate.Name: Grave Lotus Distillate
grave-lotus-distillate.Description: Distilled from pale blossoms, this poison lays a cold veil over thought and circulation.

storm-eel-toxin.Name: Storm Eel Toxin
storm-eel-toxin.Description: An electrifying neurotoxin from great ocean eels makes muscles spasm uncontrollably.

widowmaker-compound.Name: Widowmaker Compound
widowmaker-compound.Description: A professional blade poison that attacks circulation and quickly wears down even robust targets.

ash-manticore-venom.Name: Ash Manticore Venom
ash-manticore-venom.Description: This gritty venom from the tail spines of volcanic manticores burns hot and makes the limbs heavy.

basilisk-bile.Name: Basilisk Bile
basilisk-bile.Description: The caustic bile of a basilisk attacks muscles and nerves, making movement increasingly rigid.

red-crown-serpent-venom.Name: Red-Crown Serpent Venom
red-crown-serpent-venom.Description: The potent venom of this mountain snake disrupts heartbeat and balance and can leave victims nearly unable to move.

emperor-scorpion-venom.Name: Emperor Scorpion Venom
emperor-scorpion-venom.Description: The heavy venom of a giant emperor scorpion causes tissue damage and collapse of circulation.

voidwasp-venom.Name: Voidwasp Venom
voidwasp-venom.Description: The venom of extraplanar wasps chills the blood while gnawing at vitality and perception.

wyrm-gall-toxin.Name: Wyrm Gall Toxin
wyrm-gall-toxin.Description: Refined from the gall of a poison-resistant dragon, this toxin reacts violently to magical energy in the body.

nightglass-poison.Name: Nightglass Poison
nightglass-poison.Description: An occult blade poison whose black crystals fracture sensation and break thoughts into false images.

starved-god-ichor.Description: This forbidden poison is refined from alien ichor and makes flesh wither while craving impossible nourishment.
